scope: First bounded real-public-structure receiving/import/snapshot/screening pilot. Three Compound CIDs, one explicitly identified computed conformer per CID. Software/provenance pilot, no biological/activity/affinity/stock/large-library claim.
provider_status: Local provider clean, 32 commits behind fetched origin/main; preserve it and actual environment, no update/merge/rebuild.

acquisition.route: Fixed case-specific original-byte HTTP receiving in owned capsule; not a reusable PHMT molecular downloader or qualified PubChem connector.
acquisition.choice: First native conformer ID in the received diverse order; keep complete original listing.
acquisition.redirects: https pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov only; record requested/final URL
acquisition.throttling: Stop all further requests on red/black X-Throttling-Control; no 2D/name/alternate-host or second-conformer fallback.
response_evidence: selected headers including content-type and throttling
original bytes or bounded truncation marker
acquisition.source_type: PubChem Compound/CID plus computed conformer ID; no invented depositor SID.

preparation.loss_rule: Retain original SDF unchanged outside native domains. Reject any other reported conversion loss; never call the import lossless. This is ordinary compound data, not PHMT annotated-SDF schema migration.
preparation.chemical_state: Retain supplied state, charges, bonds and indexed hydrogens; no protonation/neutralization/tautomer/fragment/hydrogen/conformer generation.
preparation.aromaticity: Explicit public msm.physchem.get_aromaticity followed by aligned public msm.set annotations; no direct RDKit or private provider call.
preparation.readiness: Record public get_chemical_readiness/get_hydrogen_inventory before/after; target recognition must still succeed under its own native prerequisites.
preparation.snapshot: Public MolSysMT SDF->MolSys->file:h5msm->MolSys, explicit float_precision=double, no interactions embedded.
preparation.roundtrip: Atom IDs/types, formal charges, aromatic flags, bond index mapping, state/frame counts preserved; coordinates compared explicitly in nm atol1e-12.
preparation.all_or_stop: All three fixed records must be received and prepared before screening; preserve each failure and do not replace IDs or shrink the selection silently.

query.construction: PHMT from_ligand(features=[hb acceptor],radius=0.15 nm), save native JSON; no selecting feature subset after scoring.
query.evaluation: one received source frame, reference chemical state, all source atoms; on_error=record
query.oracle: Reference caffeine must admit its own triplet-seeded hit with binary score1 if query/native eligibility passes. Other library scores are observations, not biological truth labels.
query.source_mappings: Stable work keys include CID/native conformer/source frame; source key CID, original occurrence in frozen order. Distinct CIDs do not prove molecular/series independence.
query.recovery_control: Commit first work item, close/reopen run, finish pending work; first committing attempt remains singular. Saved full outcomes compared against composed native reference using identical effective settings.
query.geometry_control: Optional predeclared public proper translation of reference caffeine [1,2,3] nm, in_place=False, must preserve seeded binary self-hit; source bytes unchanged.
query.failure: Budget/recognition/preparation failures remain unscored with original cause. No tolerance/budget/feature/source changes to force a pass.

rights.usage: Local bounded scientific-software pilot; preserve source-specific provenance, no blanket CC0 claim.
rights.publication: Original HTTP bodies, molecular SDF/H5MSM and geometry-bearing query/results stay in owned local capsule pending complete redistribution assessment. Publish own code, request/status/hash manifest and scalar scientific projection; no clinical/contributor annotation prose.

excluded: Biological retrospective validation or replacement of #103/#66/#106 inputs
